shortDescription: Manage web filter security profiles in FortiManager

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: comment
options.description: Optional comments.

options.name: extended_log
options.description: Enable/disable extended logging for web filtering. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: ftgd_wf
options.description: EXPERTS ONLY! KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API IS REQUIRED! List of multiple child objects to be added. Expects a list of dictionaries. Dictionaries must use FortiManager API parameters, not the ansible ones listed below. If submitted, all other prefixed sub-parameters ARE IGNORED. This object is MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with its options. We expect that you know what you are doing with these list parameters, and are leveraging the JSON API Guide. WHEN IN DOUBT, USE THE SUB OPTIONS BELOW INSTEAD TO CREATE OB

options.name: ftgd_wf_exempt_quota
options.description: Do not stop quota for these categories.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_action
options.description: Action to take for matches. choice | block | Block access. choice | monitor | Allow access while logging the action. choice | warning | Allow access after warning the user. choice | authenticate | Authenticate user before allowing access.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_auth_usr_grp
options.displayName: Ftgd Wf Filters Auth Usr Grp
options.description: Groups with permission to authenticate.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_category
options.description: Categories and groups the filter examines.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_log
options.description: Enable/disable logging. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_override_replacemsg
options.description: Override replacement message.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_warn_duration
options.description: Duration of warnings.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_warning_duration_type
options.displayName: Ftgd Wf Filters Warning Duration Type
options.description: Re-display warning after closing browser or after a timeout. choice | session | After session ends. choice | timeout | After timeout occurs.

options.name: ftgd_wf_filters_warning_prompt
options.description: Warning prompts in each category or each domain. choice | per-domain | Per-domain warnings. choice | per-category | Per-category warnings.

options.name: ftgd_wf_max_quota_timeout
options.description: Maximum FortiGuard quota used by single page view in seconds (excludes streams).

options.name: ftgd_wf_options
options.description: Options for FortiGuard Web Filter. FLAG Based Options. Specify multiple in list form. flag | error-allow | Allow web pages with a rating error to pass through. flag | rate-server-ip | Rate the server IP in addition to the domain name. flag | connect-request-bypass | Bypass connection which has CONNECT request. flag | ftgd-disable | Disable FortiGuard scanning.

options.name: ftgd_wf_ovrd
options.description: Allow web filter profile overrides.

options.name: ftgd_wf_quota_category
options.description: FortiGuard categories to apply quota to (category action must be set to monitor).

options.name: ftgd_wf_quota_duration
options.description: Duration of quota.

options.name: ftgd_wf_quota_override_replacemsg
options.description: Override replacement message.

options.name: ftgd_wf_quota_type
options.description: Quota type. choice | time | Use a time-based quota. choice | traffic | Use a traffic-based quota.

options.name: ftgd_wf_quota_unit
options.description: Traffic quota unit of measurement. choice | B | Quota in bytes. choice | KB | Quota in kilobytes. choice | MB | Quota in megabytes. choice | GB | Quota in gigabytes.

options.name: ftgd_wf_quota_value
options.description: Traffic quota value.

options.name: ftgd_wf_rate_crl_urls
options.description: Enable/disable rating CRL by URL. choice | disable | Disable rating CRL by URL. choice | enable | Enable rating CRL by URL.

options.name: ftgd_wf_rate_css_urls
options.description: Enable/disable rating CSS by URL. choice | disable | Disable rating CSS by URL. choice | enable | Enable rating CSS by URL.

options.name: ftgd_wf_rate_image_urls
options.description: Enable/disable rating images by URL. choice | disable | Disable rating images by URL (blocked images are replaced with blanks). choice | enable | Enable rating images by URL (blocked images are replaced with blanks).

options.name: ftgd_wf_rate_javascript_urls
options.description: Enable/disable rating JavaScript by URL. choice | disable | Disable rating JavaScript by URL. choice | enable | Enable rating JavaScript by URL.

options.name: https_replacemsg
options.description: Enable replacement messages for HTTPS. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: inspection_mode
options.description: Web filtering inspection mode. choice | proxy | Proxy. choice | flow-based | Flow based.

options.name: log_all_url
options.description: Enable/disable logging all URLs visited. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values

options.name: name
options.description: Profile name.

options.name: options
options.description: FLAG Based Options. Specify multiple in list form. flag | block-invalid-url | Block sessions contained an invalid domain name. flag | jscript | Javascript block. flag | js | JS block. flag | vbs | VB script block. flag | unknown | Unknown script block. flag | wf-referer | Referring block. flag | intrinsic | Intrinsic script block. flag | wf-cookie | Cookie block. flag | per-user-bwl | Per-user black/white list filter flag | activexfilter | ActiveX filter. flag | cookiefilter | Cookie filter. fla
